fields.label: Active
fields.help: If true, apply this rule to conversations.

fields.label: Assessment Rule ID
fields.help: A unique ID for the new AssessmentRule.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: Display Name of the assessment rule.

fields.label: Conversation Filter
fields.help: To specify the filter for the conversions that should apply this sample rule.

fields.label: Dimension
fields.help: Group by dimension to sample the conversation.

fields.label: Sample Percentage
fields.help: Percentage of conversations that we should sample based on the dimension between [0, 100].

fields.label: Sample Row
fields.help: Number of the conversations that we should sample based on the dimension.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: The timezone to use for the groc expression.
